research_status: COMPLETE — all 500 episodes classified canon/filler/mixed, replacing the prior 100-episode partial dataset. Sourced from a comprehensive community Reddit breakdown, corroborated by several other closely-matching Reddit threads (per Andreas, 2026-08-22) — treated as the authoritative source over the prior dataset's per-arc citations (Wikipedia + two filler guides), which only covered episodes 1-44 and 57-112 and left 45-56 unresolved due to a source disagreement this new breakdown resolves. Cross-checked against the previously-loaded 100 episodes: 79/100 agreed exactly; 21 (episodes 1-19, 24-25) were corrected from canon to mixed per this source; episode 28 (this source's one 'Anime Canon' entry, decided 2026-08-22 to map to canon) needed no change since it was already canon.

citation_sources.description: Community-compiled Reddit breakdown covering all 500 episodes of Naruto: Shippuuden (manga canon / mixed canon-filler / filler, plus one 'anime canon' episode mapped to canon here), corroborated by several other closely-matching Reddit threads.
